messages.subject: Eurobank Resourcing | Director-Level Corporate Affairs, ESG & Regulatory Executive
messages.body:
Dear Eurobank Resourcing Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior international opportunities where corporate affairs, government and regulatory relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational mining operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This gives me a useful combination of financial-sector perspective, public-institution engagement, sustainability leadership and executive-level stakeholder management.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached a Eurobank-tailored executive CV for review and future matching. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates across the Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
